title: FOXK1 induced upregulation of KIF20A promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression via Wnt/beta-Catenin/EMT signaling.
authors: Liu, Jiaxuan; Zhang, Meng; Li, Jialing; Tian, Yu; Zhao, Jinyan; Liu, Xue
journal: Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FOXK1转录因子通过ChIP-seq验证其直接结合KIF20A启动子并激活转录，但核心是HCC肿瘤进展机制，TF-DNA互作仅作为上游调控环节，缺乏AI/物理模拟建模方法。
abstract: Liver cancer ranks sixth in incidence and third in mortality worldwide, with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) accounting for 90% of cases. Kinesin family genes (KIFs) have been implicated in HCC progression, but their specific roles remain unclear. Here, using multiple transcriptomic datasets and machine learning, we systematically screened KIF genes in HCC and identified nine key differentially expressed KIFs (KIF3A, KIF3B, KIF5B, KIF11, KIF13A, KIF13B, KIF20A, KIFC3, KLC2) as diagnostic biomarkers. A logistic regression model showed excellent diagnostic accuracy (AUC = 0.992) in the GSE121248 dataset. Six genes (KIF3A, KIF5B, KIF11, KIF13B, KIF20A, KLC2) were validated in TCGA, several correlating with prognosis. Notably, KIF20A was an independent prognostic factor, validated across cohorts. Single-cell and experimental data revealed high KIF20A expression in HCC cells, promoting proliferation and migration. Mechanistically, KIF20A drives tumor growth and metastasis via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) proteins such as N-cadherin, Slug, Snail, and Twist1/2. Wnt pathway activator SKL2001 and inhibitor LGK974 confirmed KIF20A's role in tumor progression. Upstream, the transcription factor FOXK1 was identified as a key positive regulator of KIF20A. FOXK1 is overexpressed in HCC, strongly correlates with KIF20A, and predicts poor prognosis. ChIP-seq and promoter assays verified FOXK1's direct binding to the KIF20A promoter, activating its transcription. In conclusion, KIF20A serves as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker promoting HCC progression via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, regulated by FOXK1, offering new therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 肝癌在全球发病率排名第六，死亡率排名第三，其中肝细胞癌（HCC）占病例的90%。驱动蛋白家族基因（KIFs）已被涉及在HCC进展中，但其具体作用仍不清楚。在此，利用多个转录组数据集和机器学习，我们系统筛选了HCC中的KIF基因，并鉴定出九个关键差异表达的KIFs（KIF3A、KIF3B、KIF5B、KIF11、KIF13A、KIF13B、KIF20A、KIFC3、KLC2）作为诊断生物标志物。逻辑回归模型在GSE121248数据集中显示出优异的诊断准确性（AUC = 0.992）。六个基因（KIF3A、KIF5B、KIF11、KIF13B、KIF20A、KLC2）在TCGA中得到验证，其中几个与预后相关。值得注意的是，KIF20A是一个独立的预后因素，并在多个队列中得到验证。单细胞和实验数据显示，KIF20A在HCC细胞中高表达，促进增殖和迁移。机制上，KIF20A通过Wnt/β-catenin信号通路和上皮-间质转化（EMT）蛋白（如N-cadherin、Slug、Snail和Twist1/2）驱动肿瘤生长和转移。Wnt通路激活剂SKL2001和抑制剂LGK974证实了KIF20A在肿瘤进展中的作用。在上游，转录因子FOXK1被鉴定为KIF20A的关键正调控因子。FOXK1在HCC中过表达，与KIF20A强相关，并预测不良预后。ChIP-seq和启动子实验验证了FOXK1直接结合KIF20A启动子，激活其转录。总之，KIF20A作为诊断和预后生物标志物，通过Wnt/β-catenin信号通路促进HCC进展，受FOXK1调控，提供了新的治疗靶点。
